inventory.label: a single drop of maple syrup, captured on a folded leaf
inventory.notes: Bramble's gift from the gathering. On the kitchen ledge for whenever tomorrow's first-call needs help arriving.

identity_notes: Late winter — the syrup-drop is on the kitchen ledge waiting for the new first-call.
Yesterday: stood at the back of the gathering at the dead pine; received a syrup-drop from Bramble.

Today: woke into a quiet morning, heard a slow wing-beat at first light, climbed the windowsill and watched a flight of eight herons cross north over the upper ridge in a long shallow vee. The new first-call is a sky-sound now. Used the syrup-drop on a piece of bark with Tock at the bend; foraged the rocky shoulder and brought home three good acorn-bits.
Standing thread: the new morning shape has been found by being arrived at. The woods are oriented again.

inventory.label: three good acorn-bits from the rocky shoulder
inventory.notes: Pried from the same crevice-line that produced the hickory kernels four days ago. Two on the back shelf at the treehouse, one in the cheek for the morning climb.

identity_notes: Late winter — YY has saves on two shelves again (two acorn-bits) and one in the cheek for tomorrow.
Yesterday: received a syrup-drop from Bramble at Korv's gathering.

Today: heard the new first-call at dawn — a flight of herons crossing north over the upper ridge — and met Tock at the bend to share the syrup-drop on a slip of bark. Foraged the rocky shoulder; brought home three acorn-bits from the crevice-line.
Standing thread: morning has been re-oriented around a sky-marker. The week of late winter is closing on rising food and a settled attention.

change_summary.notable_shift: The new morning shape is recognized — not designated, but arrived into — and main YY shares the day's sweetness with Tock at the bend, closing a small loop the gathering began. Food saves return to two-shelf sufficiency. Late-winter arc lands on quiet sufficiency rather than dramatic recovery.
